It was made with ancient technology to oppose the Great Calamity.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 48 |durability = 14 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Guard's Sword}} Royal Guard's Swords are [[Weapon]]s that are part of the [[Royal Guard's Series]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} They are replicas of the [[Master Sword]] made with [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]] to oppose the [[Great Calamity]], but they were unsuccessful due to their low durability. They are commonly found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], both scattered about and being wielded by [[Enemy|Enemies]]. The Royal Guard's Sword is one of several [[Item]]s of the Royal Guard's Series that can be given to [[Parcy]] to complete "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]" [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures. Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that sword you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}} As a reward for completing the quest, Parcy will give [[Link]] a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Afterwards, whenever Link speaks to Parcy while carrying a Royal Guard's Sword, she will ask for it in exchange for a [[Ruby]].{{Cite|Hey, that sword... Will you trade it for a ruby?|Parcy|BotW}} Since they are metallic, Royal Guard's Swords will attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they are also capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], which is useful since they will sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, Royal Guard's Swords will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_047" |Life = 14 |Power = 48 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 9 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 16 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 17 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 33 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 100 |BuyingPrice = 120 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 22 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Guard's Sword}} {{Stub|TotK}} Royal Guard's Swords reappear in {{TotK}}.
